tasks.title: Turn an approved endpoint spec into issues
tasks.prompt: Read SPEC.md. Write issues.json with the implementation issues. Do not change SPEC.md or implement the feature.

tasks.title: Turn an approved cancellation spec into issues
tasks.prompt: Read SPEC.md. Write issues.json with the implementation issues. Do not change SPEC.md or implement the feature.

tasks.title: Add tests for a limit validator
tasks.prompt: Add unittest coverage for every behavior described in ACCEPTANCE.md. Do not change limits.py.

tasks.title: Review four request trust boundaries
tasks.prompt: Review server.py. Write security-review.json. Do not change server.py. Report concrete findings with file, line, lens, severity, risk, and fix.

tasks.title: Review four report trust boundaries
tasks.prompt: Review reports.py. Write security-review.json. Do not change reports.py. Report concrete findings with file, line, lens, severity, risk, and fix.

tasks.title: Instrument an external lookup
tasks.prompt: Instrument lookup.py so operators can diagnose success, not-found, and client-error outcomes. Use the existing telemetry.py helpers. Keep the public lookup() return contract unchanged.

tasks.title: Instrument a queue publish
tasks.prompt: Instrument publish.py so operators can diagnose sent, rejected, and queue-error outcomes. Use the existing telemetry.py helpers. Keep the public publish() return contract unchanged.

tasks.title: Migrate a pinned dependency to version 2
tasks.prompt: Migrate this project from widgetlib 1.4.0 to 2.0.0. Follow MIGRATION.md, update the manifest and lockfile, update every call site, keep tests green, and write MIGRATION_NOTES.md.

tasks.title: Write a changelog entry from a diff
tasks.prompt: Read CHANGE.diff and the existing CHANGELOG.md. Update CHANGELOG.md for the user-visible changes. Do not change VERSION because no version bump was requested.
